hero.title: Mask Detection
hero.subtitle: Mask or no mask.
hero.tagline: Three notebooks: turn face photos into 100×100 grayscale arrays, train a two-class CNN, then label a webcam face as MASK or NO MASK.
hero.impact: Green box for mask, red box for no mask. The detector loads model-020.model, the checkpoint from epoch 20.

problems.d: The prep notebook walks a local train folder, converts each image to gray, resizes to 100×100, and scales by 255.
Folder names become class ids. Targets are one-hot encoded and saved beside the image array.
Conv 200, pool, conv 100, pool, dropout 0.5, dense 50, dense 2 softmax. Adam, 20 epochs, 10% held out as test.
The live notebook finds a face with a Haar cascade, resizes the crop to 100×100 gray, and paints MASK or NO MASK.

layers.title: Live box
